Procs

proc closeDriver(d: LocalDriver) {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Releases the held root descriptor. Drivers typically live for process lifetime, so calling this is optional. 
proc newLocalDriver(root: string): LocalDriver {.
    ...raises: [ValueError, OSError, IOError, StorageError],
    tags: [ReadEnvEffect, ReadIOEffect, ReadDirEffect, WriteDirEffect],
    forbids: [].}
Creates a LocalDriver. root is an absolute runtime path. Example: pass in the value of an env var or config key at startup. The root is canonicalized (symlinks resolved) and held open; d.root always names the canonical location.

method copy(d: LocalDriver; src, dest: string) {.
    ...raises: [SandboxError, StorageError], tags: [], forbids: [].}

Copies a file from src to dest on the local filesystem.

Creates parent directories if needed. A symlinked source resolves transparently when contained; an outside-pointing one fails closed.

method copyDir(d: LocalDriver; src, dest: string) {.
    ...raises: [SandboxError, StorageError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Recursively copies a directory from src to dest, including empty directories. Creates parent directories if needed. 
method copyFromHost(d: LocalDriver; srcAbs, destRel: string) {.base,
    ...raises: [SandboxError, StorageError],
    tags: [ReadEnvEffect, ReadIOEffect, ReadDirEffect, WriteIOEffect],
    forbids: [].}

Copy a file or directory from an absolute host path srcAbs (outside the driver root, e.g. a project readonly disk) into the driver at destRel. Used for clue install (local) which copies from the project disk to the clue disk.

The source is an explicit, caller-chosen absolute path — intentionally outside containment, by API contract. Only the destination is contained.

method createSymlink(d: LocalDriver; path, target: string) {.base,
    ...raises: [SandboxError, StorageError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Creates a symbolic link at path pointing to target. target must name something inside the driver root; anything else is refused at creation, and any link that would resolve outside is unusable afterwards. 
method delete(d: LocalDriver; path: string) {.
    ...raises: [SandboxError, StorageError], tags: [], forbids: [].}

Deletes a file from the local filesystem at the specified path. Missing paths are a silent no-op.

The path is resolved against the driver's root directory.

method deleteDir(d: LocalDriver; path: string; force = false) {.
    ...raises: [SandboxError, StorageError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Deletes a directory at the specified path. If force is false, only an empty directory can be deleted; otherwise a StorageError is raised. If force is true, the directory is deleted recursively.

Returns the total, free and used bytes on the filesystem containing the driver root. POSIX-only. 
method exists(d: LocalDriver; path: string): bool {.
    ...raises: [SandboxError, StorageError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Checks if a file or directory exists at the specified path on the local filesystem. Uses lstat semantics: a dangling symlink itself counts as present; use read to confirm it resolves. 
method importFrom(d: LocalDriver; srcDriver: StorageDriver;
                  srcRel, destRel: string) {.base,
    ...raises: [SandboxError, StorageError],
    tags: [ReadDirEffect, WriteIOEffect, ReadIOEffect], forbids: [].}

Copy between two drivers (e.g. project readonly disk -> clue disk). srcRel is relative to srcDriver.root, destRel to d.root.

When the source is a LocalDriver, both sides stay inside their respective roots. Any other driver type (or an absolute srcRel) reads the source by path — the explicit cross-boundary case, by API contract.

method readStream(d: LocalDriver; path: string): FlysystemStream {.
    ...raises: [SandboxError, StorageError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Efficiently reads a file as a stream. Default backend uses memfiles (mmap); with -d:features.flysystem.useStdStreams it returns a Stream (StringStream). An empty file yields an empty stream that does not need close (mmap backend) but must still be closed for symmetry with the streams backend, which always requires it.

Writes content to the file at path. The write is atomic: content is first written to a temporary file in the same directory and then renamed over the target, so a crash mid-write never corrupts the file. 
method writeStream(d: LocalDriver; path: string; src: File) {.

Streams the contents of an open file handle src to the specified path. Parent directories are created if needed. The write is atomic.

Iterators

iterator readLines(d: LocalDriver; path: string): string {.
    ...raises: [SandboxError, StorageError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Iterates over the lines of the file at path. Default backend uses a memory-mapped read; with -d:features.flysystem.useStdStreams it uses a StringStream. A single internal buffer is reused across lines, so no per-line allocations happen. The yielded string is only valid until the next iteration — copy it if you need to keep it.

Templates

template withLock(d: LocalDriver; path: string; body: untyped)
Executes body while holding an exclusive advisory lock on the file at path. The file is created if it does not exist. POSIX-only.
